data.one_liner: Executes periodic background callbacks on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple plugin to wake the app in the background roughly every 15 minutes and run a user‑provided callback. Supports Android headless mode and iOS background‑fetch limits.
use_when: You need to run lightweight code periodically while the app is in the background or terminated (e.g., sync, analytics).
You want a cross‑platform solution that works with both Android and iOS without writing native code yourself.
avoid_when: Precise timing or intervals shorter than 15 minutes are required.
You need guaranteed execution on iOS when the app is terminated.
strengths: Very simple API – just configure and provide a callback.
Supports Android headless execution after app termination.
weaknesses: Cannot fire more frequently than ~15 minutes and OS may throttle further.
iOS stops delivering events when the app is terminated or background refresh is disabled.
data.setup_notes: Add required permissions to AndroidManifest (e.g., RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED), enable background fetch in iOS (Info.plist) and configure the plugin in native code (AppDelegate/Android Application).
